name: Philip Labonte
description: '''Philip Steven Labonte''' (born April 15, 1975) is an American singer, best known as the lead singer of the [[Heavy metal music|heavy metal]] band [[All That Remains (band)|All That Remains]]. He is the former lead vocalist for [[Shadows Fall]] and filled in for [[Killswitch Engage]] in early 2010, as well as for [[Five Finger Death Punch]] in late 2016.
